title: Legacy UFO program secrecy rooted in the Manhattan Project and the 1954 Atomic Energy Act

tellings.quote: specifically legacy programs starting with the same secrecy mechanisms as the Manhattan project and the 1954 atomic energy agreement birthing a lot of the secrecy behind uh UFO legacy program classification and controls.

plain: Someone who goes by the online name UAPGerb, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, draws on what a witness named David Grusch said in an interview with podcaster Joe Rogan. The claim is that long-running secret government UFO programs, called legacy programs, were built on the same secrecy rules as the Manhattan Project, the US wartime effort to build the atomic bomb, and on the 1954 Atomic Energy Act, a US law controlling nuclear secrets. If so, the rules that hid nuclear weapons work would also be what keeps UFO programs hidden.
